name: STDEVPA
description: STDEVPA calculates the population standard deviation (n denominator) while treating text as 0 and logical values TRUE as 1 and FALSE as 0.
tldr: Population standard deviation that also counts text and logicals as numbers.

parameters.name: value1
parameters.description: The first value, range, or reference in the population.

basicExample.description: Population standard deviation of numeric values only
basicExample.explanation: With only numbers present, STDEVPA returns the same result as STDEVP.

advancedExamples.title: Text and TRUE are counted
advancedExamples.scenario: A range that mixes numbers, text, and a logical
advancedExamples.description: Text becomes 0 and TRUE becomes 1 before the calculation
advancedExamples.explanation: The values used are 10,20,30,1,0; the mean is 12.2, the population variance is 131.36, and the square root is 11.4612426.

advancedExamples.title: Contrast with STDEVP on a reference
advancedExamples.description: STDEVP ignores text and logicals inside a range
advancedExamples.explanation: STDEVP sees only 10,20,30 (n=3) and returns 10, whereas STDEVPA counts all five values.

howItWorks: STDEVPA coerces every argument to a number (text to 0, TRUE to 1, FALSE to 0), then computes the population standard deviation using the n denominator. Because it divides by n rather than n-1, it assumes the supplied values constitute the whole population.

howToSteps.name: Identify values
howToSteps.text: Collect the values, including any text or logicals you want counted.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The population standard deviation including non-numerics is shown.

limitations: Counting text as 0 can distort the result if text cells are labels rather than true zeros.
Dividing by n assumes a full population; for a sample use STDEVA.
Requires at least one effective value, otherwise returns #DIV/0!.

commonErrors.cause: No effective numeric values after coercion.
commonErrors.fix: Provide at least one value that evaluates to a number.

commonErrors.cause: Text labels were coerced to 0, pulling the mean down.
commonErrors.fix: Use STDEVP when text cells should be ignored.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: STDEVPA is available in Google Sheets with the same coercion rules.

faq.question: Does STDEVPA treat empty cells as 0?
faq.answer: No. Empty cells are ignored; only text and logicals are coerced (text to 0, TRUE to 1, FALSE to 0).

faq.question: When should I use STDEVPA instead of STDEVP?
faq.answer: When your data includes logicals or text that genuinely represent 1/0 or zero, and you want them in the population.

faq.question: What is the sample equivalent?
faq.answer: STDEVA, which uses the n-1 denominator instead of n.
